transcript: Speaker A: तुम्हारी पापा कहाँ हैं? [Where is your dad?] Speaker B: My dad is out town work. You will see improvement in a few days. Come on, get started.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A woman corrects a boy's English grammar in a split-screen setup and introduces him to the English Seekho app. She highlights its affordability, convenience of 15-20 minutes of daily practice, and a 1-rupee trial offer. The ad concludes with a call to action to install the app.
